description: Source code for managing and processing templates, including splitting templates into parts, registering static templates, and retrieving templates asynchronously.

classes.name: SplitTemplate
classes.description: Represents a template split into before, list content, and after parts.

classes.name: AllTemplates
classes.description: Manages handlebars templates, including static embedding and retrieval.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the 'before_list' template if available.

methods.name: split_template
methods.description: Splits a given template into before, list content, and after parts based on helper blocks.

methods.name: from_str_with_state
methods.description: Asynchronously compiles a template from a string with application state.

methods.name: is_template_list_item
methods.description: Checks if a template element is an 'each_row' helper block.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes AllTemplates with helper registration and static templates.

methods.name: preregister_static_templates
methods.description: Embeds predefined templates into the binary in release mode.

methods.name: template_path
methods.description: Constructs a PathBuf for a template given its name.

methods.name: get_template
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a template by name, with context.

methods.name: get_static_template
methods.description: Retrieves a static embedded template by name.
